name: Master
source:
The owner of the café "Shasha" located near Kyobashi Station. He inherited the café from his grandfather, and he's able to manage it comfortably on his own. He's friendly, cheerful, and caring towards others in a big sisterly sort of way. Despite his feminine demeanor and looks, he still considers himself to be a man.

He likes to look after others, so whenever Memory, one of his regulars, pops in, he lets her have a meal or dessert on the house. He follows trends closely and is into beauty and makeup. On his days off, he seems to keep up with Korean idols. Not much is known about his background, but he has a lot of life experience. He's also bisexual and has over 100 ex-partners.

He seems to have a long-distance boyfriend right now, but no one is sure.
[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2943040]Steam[/url]]
